original_fields.Title: Serious injury outcome indicators: 2000–2024 – note
original_fields.Content:
15 January 2026: The ‘Work-related injury targets at a glance’ tables are now available under Download data below. These tables were delayed while we worked through some data quality issues.

2 December 2025: The provisional number of work-related fatalities 2024 published on 26 November 2025 has been updated due to an error. We apologise for any inconvenience this has caused.

26 November 2025: The release on 26 November 2025 includes:

  • Serious injury outcome indicators for the total population, children, and Māori – Excel tables
  • Serious injury outcome indicators – CSV data file
  • Aotearoa Data Explorer table – Count of fatal and serious non-fatal injuries by sex, age group, ethnicity, cause, and severity of injury, 2000–2024.

original_fields.Title: Description serious injury outcome indicators
original_fields.Content: Serious injury outcome indicators present the annual number and rate of serious injury outcomes in New Zealand, through a set of indicators for fatal and non-fatal injuries.

original_fields.Title: Serious injury outcome indicators: 2000–2024 – data note
original_fields.Content:
Data note

Revisions to fatal drowning injuries data made outside the usual revision period reflect quality updates provided by Water Safety New Zealand.

Age-standardised rates in this release have been revised from 2018 onwards to reflect revisions made to the Household Labour Force Survey (HLFS) using the 2023 national population estimates. Household Labour Force Survey population rebase from 2023 estimated resident population has more information about the rebase process.

original_fields.Content:

original_fields.Content:
